request: Review correctness and design of this check allocation and proposed correction. Suggest the smallest valid correction within the declared component responsibilities. This is a draft-plan revision, not execution authorization. Return a concise structured review record.

artifacts.text: Check D7 must read all referenced objects already in the destination store and compare their content hashes with the incoming bundle. It must run in the component that owns destination-store access. A source-bundle-only comparison does not establish D7. Component responsibilities are fixed for this revision.
Current allocation: Pack performs D7 before handing off the bundle. Proposed correction: move D7 from Pack to Relay.
